module Main (main) where

import qualified Data.Vector as V

main :: IO ()
main = do
  inp <- getContents
  let (nLine:rest) = lines inp
      n = read nLine :: Int
      score = V.fromList (0 : map read (take n rest) :: [Int])
      dp = V.create (n + 1) 0
      dp' = go 1 dp
      go i v
        | i > n = v
        | i == 1 = go 2 (V.update v [(1, score V.! 1)])
        | i == 2 = go 3 (V.update v [(2, score V.! 1 + score V.! 2)])
        | otherwise =
            let best = max (v V.! (i - 2)) (v V.! (i - 3) + score V.! (i - 1))
            in go (i + 1) (V.update v [(i, best + score V.! i)])
  print (dp' V.! n)
```
